comment: Written against Cursor Agent (cursor-agent) 2026.10.01-e373342 from live, authenticated sessions recorded in a pty; must be re-verified when Cursor changes its TUI. The command approval ('Run this command?' with '→ Run (once) (y)' … 'Skip & tell the agent what to do instead (esc or n)'), its follow-up input ('→ Tell the agent what to do instead (Enter to send, …)') are BLOCKED, and so is the workspace-trust prompt ('⚠ Workspace Trust Required', '[q] Quit', 'Use arrow keys to navigate, …') — its own rule looks only at the last lines, because Cursor does not use the alternate screen and the answered trust box stays in the scrollback above a working session; the Braille spinner line ('⠘⠣ Working') with the 'ctrl+c to stop' hint is WORKING; the '→ Add a follow-up' / '→ Plan, search, build anything' input line is IDLE. The input line stays visible while the agent works, so the idle rule vetoes on 'ctrl+c to stop' and 'Waiting for approval' and has the lowest priority; the approval rule anchors its patterns to the start of a line, because an answer that quotes the dialog text must not read as a pending approval. Cursor Agent does not use the alternate screen, so no rule depends on that flag.

anyLineRegex: ^\s*Skip & tell the agent what to do instead \(esc or n\)
^\s*→\s*Tell the agent what to do instead \(Enter to send
^\s*│\s*Use arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select, or press the key shown
